title: See what is still open on a release
statement: As a developer, I can see the facts about a release that is not out yet, so whoever decides to ship can decide with everything in front of them.
overview: Proposed addition. The format records and the team decides, the same stance as `status` and review decisions.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `release status` lists unchecked steps, stories with no code reference, delivered stories that no note mentions, and stories with no merged review found through their Tasks or Items.
It gives no score or ready/not-ready answer and exits 0 whenever it can read the Saga; `--json` carries the same facts for a rule a team writes in its own CI.
Nothing in validation, `status` or `check --covers health` fails because of what `release status` lists.
